product_one_liner.value: SurveySparrow is an AI-enabled customer-experience and Voice-of-Customer platform for organizations to collect customer and employee feedback across channels, analyze it, and turn insights into follow-ups and actions.

eng_blog.notes: The engineering publication describes developer-written technology stories and includes technical posts on webhooks and SLO/reliability.

public_docs.notes: The public help center has multiple topic collections and the developer portal includes API and SDK documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current board lists eight open roles, none with an AI, ML, machine-learning, or data-science title.

model_provider.value: SurveySparrow says its generative-AI features use OpenAI (US) and Azure OpenAI (EU); AWS also reports that SurveySparrow uses Anthropic Claude Sonnet in Amazon Bedrock for real-time summarization, clustering, and sentiment scoring.

compliance_certs.notes: PCI DSS is not listed as a SurveySparrow certification on the cited security page.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile identifies this as the latest round and reports one round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round was in April 2019, before the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live posting is for Business Development Representative - US.

launched_6mo.notes: SurveySparrow announced the launch of Echo on September 17, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Available public leadership information reports no publicly announced executive hires or departures in the period; the executive team page lists two people.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These are explicitly listed as CRM integrations.
